met_analysis:
The Well-Marked Low Pressure area over northern parts of central Uttar Pradesh weakened into a Low Pressure Area over the same region at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 27th September 2026. The associated cyclonic circulation extends upto 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & Upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 7.6 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 72°E to the north of Lat. 24°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over northeast Assam & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The low pressure area over south coastal Myanmar & neighbourhood emerged into north Andaman Sea & adjoining Myanmar coast and lay as a Well Marked Low Pressure Area over the same region at 1730 hrs IST of today, the 27th September 2026. It is likely to move north-northwestwards and concentrated into a Depression during next 24 hours. It is likely to continue to move north-northwestwards along and off Myanmar–Bangladesh coasts towards northeast Bay of Bengal & adjoining Bangladesh during subsequent 2 days.
The north-south trough from Bihar to Westcentral Bay of Bengal across Jharkhand, Odisha extending upto 3.1 km above mean sea level persists.
